verdict.rationale: The only headless-relevant evidence is scriptable setup. `codex plugin marketplace add` manages marketplace sources from the command line instead of editing config by hand. A hands-on probe also ran a fully non-interactive, keyless `npx -y skills add openai/plugins ... -y` install that placed a valid skill into a scratch directory. Nothing shows plugins or skills actually executing headlessly or in a CI pipeline; the documented flows use interactive `/plugins`, `/skills`, the plugin browser, and new-session steps. Missing for 10: documented headless/non-interactive execution of plugin skills/tools, CI integration guidance (e.g., exec mode, CI auth/secrets), and hands-on evidence of plugins running in CI.
